parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by ensuring that `get_feature_names` does not raise `NotFittedError` when the vocabulary is provided. The change is minimal and does not introduce any apparent regressions.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding an unnecessary check for `hasattr(self, 'vocabulary_')` since `_validate_vocabulary` will set it if it doesn't exist.
